refsection.title: Introduction
refsection.para: sciCV is the Scilab interface to the OpenCV library (in version 2.4.13). It gives access to almost all the functions of OpenCV in Scilab in a friendly manner.

Almost all the OpenCV functions are available under the same name in Scilab. There are changes in the argument passing (as Scilab functions can return multiple values). These changes will be resumed in this documentation (not yet documented).

The following platforms (for now) are supported:
Linux (64 bits) Windows (64 bits) Mac OSx (64 bits)
No installation of OpenCV, or system configuration are needed to use sciCV. The toolbox embeds all the necessary OpenCV binaries, whatever the platform is.
Once the toolbox loaded in Scilab, the only operation needed is to initialize the module with scicv_Init().
